_readme: Societies shown in question charts. counts = number of people at life satisfaction 0,1,...,10 (100 people each). Used by questions.ts (the apps) AND by the scoring in study-worker/scripts – the answer key for 'which society has the higher mean / higher floor / larger spread' is worked out from these numbers, so if you change a chart the scoring follows automatically. Baseline (pre_*) and post-test (post_*) use different shapes and a different answer pattern to limit practice effects: baseline A = higher mean + larger spread, B = higher floor; post-test 1 = higher mean + higher floor, 2 = larger spread. Mean gaps ~1 point so the average can be judged by eye.
